title: Binary Tree Right Side View
statement: Imagine standing on the right side of the tree. Return the values of the nodes you can see, from top to bottom.
reference_solution:
def rightSideView(root):
    out = []
    level = [root] if root else []
    while level:
        out.append(level[-1].val)
        level = [c for n in level for c in (n.left, n.right) if c]
    return out

hints.1_question: Which node of each level is visible from the right?
hints.2_nudge: Do a level-order traversal and keep the last node of every level.
hints.3_big_hint: level = [root]; while level: out.append(level[-1].val); level = all children of the level.
